title: WCAG 2.2 text resizing to 200 percent
statement:
WCAG 2.2 requires web text to remain usable when users enlarge it to 200% without losing content or functionality, so responsive interfaces should preserve readable text and controls throughout at least a 2× text-size increase.

Options:
- WCAG baseline: 200% (fits: professional, balanced)
- Extra headroom: 250% (fits: accessible, robust)
- High enlargement: 300% (fits: access-first, comfortable)
- Extreme zoom support: 400% (fits: maximum access, robust)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web, web apps, responsive web. Audience: adults, seniors, general.
